```{r}
# training/validation sets for the model 
encampment_monthly_trn <- encampment_monthly|>
  filter_index(. ~ '2025 Oct')
encampment_monthly_tst <- encampment_monthly|>
  filter_index('2025 Oct' ~ .)

fit <- encampment_monthly_trn |>
  model(
    tslm_manual = TSLM(Requests ~ trend() + season()),
    tslm_auto   = TSLM(Requests ~ trend())
  )

fit |> glance()
```


```{r}
fc <- fit |> forecast(new_data = encampment_monthly_tst)

# Forecasts vs. actual
fc |> autoplot(encampment_monthly, level = NULL)

# Fitted vs. actual on training data
augment(fit) |> autoplot(Requests) + autolayer(augment(fit), .fitted)

# Residuals
fit |> select(tslm_manual) |> gg_tsresiduals()
fit |> select(tslm_auto) |> gg_tsresiduals()
```
